subject: Mid-cycle license adjustment request & proposal for co-terming
messages:
From: Claire Johnson <claire@helixai.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurements Team <procurements@helixai.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary capacity uplift + align renewal date

Hi Diego + Marissa,

Quick note from Helix AI — we’ve seen a sustained 45% higher token consumption for our recommendation pipelines over the last 6 weeks (attached is a summary). Our current Dedicated tier is hitting throttles during peak windows which is impacting latency SLAs to our customers.

Can Redwood process a mid-cycle capacity uplift (roughly +60% vGPU hours) for Oct–Dec and co-term that uplift to our renewal window? If possible we’d like:
- A short amendment for Oct–Dec with pro-rated charges
- Option to roll the uplift into our annual agreement at a discounted uplift rate
- PO guidance and any contract language we should send to procurement.

We’re on a tight timeline — customer commitments mean we need something by the end of next week. Attaching the usage report Q3.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Johnson
Head of Infrastructure
Helix AI

Attachments: usage_report_q3.csv (csv)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire@helixai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary capacity uplift + align renewal date

Hi Claire — thanks for the data, that helps.

High-level options we can move with quickly:
1) Temporary uplift amendment (Oct 1–Dec 31): +60% capacity, prorated invoicing for 3 months, same support SLA. We can add a 10% uplift discount if you commit to roll the uplift into the annual renewal.
2) Immediate dedicated burst pool + month-to-month overage: no contract change, but higher per-unit rate. Good if you need <45 days of runway.
3) Co-term conversion: we can convert the uplift into a permanent capacity add at renewal (Jan 1) with a step-down discount ladder depending on committed annual vGPU hours.

I’m attaching a draft amendment (proposed_uplift_amendment_v2.pdf) with the language procurement usually expects and two sample billing schedules. If you want, Marissa and I can join a 30-minute call with procurement to triage PO wording and timing.

If option 1 looks right, we’ll need: PO for the prorated uplift (sample accepted formats attached), and an executed amendment. I can get legal to turn around the amendment within 48 hours once we have the PO and a verbal go-ahead.

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Diego@redwood.com

Attachments: proposed_uplift_amendment_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: internal: pricing options and margin impact for Helix uplift

Diego / Karthik — quick internal thread before we lock the external reply.

Notes from my side after a quick calc:
- Baseline ARR: $1.2M; expected uplift ARR if annualized: ~+$360k.
- Temporary amendment (Oct–Dec) at list rates: ~+$42k pro-rated.
- If they convert uplift to annual at renewal and take the 10% uplift discount, incremental ARR nets ~+$324k; margin impact acceptable (expect ~28% gross margin on uplift).
- Risk: if we give deeper discount to close now (>15%) we eat into early-year operating margin and set a lower anchor for renewal. Recommend we hold 8–12% range and push for PO commitment + canary conversion clause (30–60 day performance review).

Suggested language for procurement: short amendment with explicit start/end, prorated invoice amount, clause to convert uplift into annual capacity with a 60-day notice window. Also require a signed PO that references amendment id.

I’ll be on the call with procurement if Diego schedules.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

(Internal: tagging Karthik to confirm finance signoff on 10% uplift discount.)

From: Procurements Team <procurements@helixai.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Johnson <claire@helixai.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: temporary capacity uplift + align renewal date

Diego / Marissa — thanks for the proposed amendment. Procurement has reviewed and we can confirm the following:
- We will issue PO #PO-HEL-0929 for the prorated uplift (attached).
- We accept the proposed amendment language provided we include a co-term conversion clause to fold uplift into the Jan 1 renewal with a 10% uplift discount as described.
- Please provide a final amendment PDF and DocuSign link so we can execute on our side.

We’ve attached PO_Helix_0929.pdf for your records. Look forward to the DocuSign link.

Regards,
Procurements Team
Helix AI
procurements@helixai.com

Attachments: PO_Helix_0929.pdf (pdf)
